integrity: The primary public full text was inspected at the CDF, the definition and derivation of mean inactivity time, Eqs. (11)-(15), the abstract, and the publication/MSC metadata. The exponential-integral sign was independently checked against the standard NIST definition and by direct numerical integration. A standalone checker was replayed from the packaged path.
scientific_limitations: The finding corrects the mean-inactivity formula but does not reanalyze every reliability measure in the article.
No full monotonicity classification of the corrected mean inactivity time is attempted.
A very recent unindexed author correction may exist outside the records examined.
title: The inverted ZLindley mean inactivity formula has the wrong exponential-integral sign
